svg.text: Concepts (before: measured plan; after: proposal drawn over it, not built)
BEFORE P1-1 frontier: today every empty lot is parking, every street lit
AFTER vacant ground, a market spine on the walk; lights only where houses are
BEFORE P1-2 IKARO HQ: front on the 14 m lane, back to the boulevard
AFTER the chance square made the IKARO approach; shared forecourt street; open court
BEFORE P1-4 the centre: a roundabout, the tower out of reach
AFTER zebras to the island, a promenade round the tower, the corners joined
